name: settings-sync
description: Merges a shared settings file, such as one in a synced git repo, into each machine's settings.json at session start, keeping each machine's own settings

file.title: Shared settings file
file.description: A JSON file written like settings.json, such as one in a git repo you sync across machines. ~ means your home folder. Its values replace this machine's, its lists are added to this machine's, and settings it does not name are left alone. Leave empty to do nothing.

skip.title: Settings to leave alone
skip.description: Settings this machine ignores in the shared file, separated by commas, such as env, hooks or pluginConfigs.usage-bar@hast-claude-mods. A dot reaches inside a setting. They are never written or taken out here, and /settings-sync does not list them. Leave empty to sync everything.
